commentary: With benchmark indices holding near record highs but market breadth registering a neutral 54, the deterministic gate flashes CAUTION. William O'Neil and Jesse Livermore taught that sustainable campaigns depend on broad market confirmation; low breadth warns that individual breakouts carry elevated failure risk. Stan Weinstein's discipline dictates buying only confirmed Stage 2 advances above rising moving averages while avoiding laggards. Strong institutional FPI flows into financials and real estate are offsetting selective post-earnings contractions elsewhere. In this environment, progressive exposure is mandatory: allocate capital strictly to true market leaders showing verified earnings acceleration, enforce the scanner's deterministic stops, and keep position sizing defensive until general market breadth expands.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Price holds above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, carving a rounded double-bottom cup-and-handle pattern. RSI at 63 shows constructive momentum without extension. However, volume remains unconvincing at the 982.83 trigger, requiring overhead supply absorption before an actionable Stage 2 pivot clears.
63MOONS.fundamental: Consolidated earnings fail CANSLIM criteria, reporting an operating loss and net loss of ₹40.43 crore in Q2 FY27. Three-year ROE sits at an anemic 1.01%. While the company remains virtually debt-free, negative earnings trends preclude institutional leadership reads.
63MOONS.risk: A breakdown below 886.75 invalidates the handle structure, demanding an immediate stop per Minervini risk discipline.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price maintains sequential alignment above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, trading within 1.5% of its 114.91 pivot on 1.66x volume with RSI at 61. However, base structure lacks a tight VCP contraction.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Fundamentals fail CANSLIM screens with Q2 FY27 sales sliding 56.3% and net profit dropping 25.6% YoY to ₹1.02 crore. Three-year ROE is low at 3.13%, interest coverage remains weak, and promoter holding has shrunk.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A close below 104.57 violates the moving-average support cluster, triggering a swift exit to preserve capital.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Constructive double-bottom structure resting within 1.5% of the 513.51 pivot. Price trades cleanly above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, while MACD above zero and its signal line confirms emerging Stage 2 accumulation.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Q2 FY27 marked a sharp turnaround as net profit jumped 83.2% YoY to ₹82.8 crore on 26.6% revenue growth, with EBITDA margins expanding 370 bps to 16.6%. ROCE stands at 12%, and backward integration strengthens operational traction.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails if price slips below the 455.37 stop, signaling an abortive base breakout.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout clearing a 20-session high to fresh 52-week highs on 2.96x volume. Price sits comfortably above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, demonstrating elite relative strength and institutional sponsorship.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Exceptional CANSLIM credentials: Q2 FY27 net profit rocketed 156% YoY on 45.9% sales growth, accelerating from Q1's 65.4% surge. Robust EBITDA margins of 22.1%, expanding xanthine market share, rising CDMO contracts, and conservative net debt-to-equity (0.32x) reinforce leadership.
AARTIPHARM.risk: A reversal below the 907.75 pivot stop invalidates the breakout; cut losses immediately without hesitation.

AARVI.technical: Constructive near-breakout pattern within 1.5% of the 161.16 pivot. Aligned swing lows and positive MACD momentum support the setup, with price maintaining support above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA.
AARVI.fundamental: Q1 FY27 PAT grew 42.9% YoY to ₹6.0 crore on 14.1% revenue growth. Low EBITDA margins of 2.61% reflect technical manpower contracting economics, but minimal debt and strong 73% promoter ownership underpin balance sheet stability.
AARVI.risk: Violation of the 146.04 stop breaches the consolidation floor, requiring quick capital preservation.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Classic high-conviction SEPA breakout clearing prior 20-session highs on heavy 2.87x volume. Bullish moving-average stack above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA reflects persistent institutional accumulation.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Pristine CANSLIM profile: Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT jumped 40.9% YoY to ₹1,353 crore on 32.2% top-line growth, building upon Q1's 40.7% surge. Strong loan book growth across NBFC, housing finance, and insurance segments fuels compounding ROE.
ABCAPITAL.risk: A retreat below 390.48 negates the breakout pivot, triggering an automatic risk-management exit.
